# Research report 1 of 2

I'm writing up the findings now. Several articles I found were published after the 2026-09-25 cutoff (dated September 28 and later, including October), so I left them out.

# Muse (Meta) App Store #1 research brief, as of 2026-09-25

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on Apple's US App Store Top Free iPhone chart, checked at 10am PST on 2026-10-01. No URL is given. A third-party tracker like Appfigures or Sensor Tower can also show the chart.
- My attempts to load live chart pages and several articles were blocked by the proxy, so I could not see today's chart directly.
- 2026-09-22: Daring Fireball linked a top-15 list showing Muse at #1 and ChatGPT at #2, and said Muse still held #1 in the US iOS App Store. [Daring Fireball](https://daringfireball.net/linked/2026/09/22/meta-muse-app-store)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that decides the question. By every report up to 2026-09-25, Muse is #1 on the US free iPhone chart and has held it for about a week.
- 2026-09-21: WinBuzzer reported Muse at #1 ahead of ChatGPT as of 10:55 UTC on September 19. [WinBuzzer](https://winbuzzer.com/2026/09/21/metas-muse-ai-agent-tops-us-iphone-free-app-chart-a003-xcxwbn/)
- 2026-09-18: 9to5Mac reported that Muse had passed ChatGPT for #1 among free iPhone apps in the US. A summary of other reporting dates this to September 18, citing Sensor Tower. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/18/metas-new-muse-ai-agent-app-overtakes-chatgpt-as-top-iphone-app/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-25: TechCrunch, "Meta is putting its muscle behind Muse as the AI app takes off." Install estimates as of Thursday, Sep 24: about 2.3M from Appfigures (split roughly evenly between iOS and Android), over 3.4M from Sensor Tower, and 4.3M from Apptopia. Muse is available only in the US and Canada. The headline suggests Meta is actively promoting the app. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/25/meta-is-putting-its-muscle-behind-muse-as-the-ai-app-takes-off)
- 2026-09-24: Siècle Digital reported that Muse's downloads are surging and that it has passed ChatGPT on the App Store. [Siècle Digital](https://siecledigital.fr/2026/09/24/la-nouvelle-ia-de-meta-affole-les-telechargements-et-depasse-chatgpt-sur-lapp-store/)
- 2026-09-22: Muse reached #1 in Canada as well. [iPhone in Canada](https://www.iphoneincanada.ca/2026/09/22/metas-muse-hits-1-in-canada-outpaces-chatgpts-early-downloads/)
- 2026-09-21: Apptopia data via TechCrunch showed 1.8M Muse downloads versus ChatGPT's 1.3M in its first 12 days (US and Canada, iOS). [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/21/metas-muse-is-outpacing-chatgpts-early-mobile-launch/)
- 2026-09-10: Muse was #2 in the US two days after its September 8 launch, up from #4. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/10/metas-ai-agent-muse-is-now-the-no-2-app-in-the-us/)
- One report says Amazon blocked Muse's agent from accessing its platform. This was a negative headline, but I found nothing linking it to a drop in rank. [Cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/metas-muse-ai-app-tops-us-app-stores-challenges-openais-chatgpt/)

## 4. Base rates
- I found no systematic data on how long new apps stay at #1 on the US free chart.
- Comparable cases: big AI launches (ChatGPT in 2023, DeepSeek in Jan 2025, Sora in Oct 2025) typically held #1 for one to several weeks. Brand promotions, such as food chains running free-item deals, sometimes take #1 for a single day.
- Muse's trajectory up to 2026-09-25 points to unusually strong momentum: it climbed steadily from #4 to #2 to #1 over about 10 days, downloads are beating ChatGPT's launch pace, and Meta is pushing it with marketing.
- One source said Muse was likely not to stay at the top for long, but it gave no data to support that. [Levelup/Gitconnected](https://levelup.gitconnected.com/metas-muse-beat-chatgpt-s-app-debut-by-38-read-the-footnotes-e3c595f459d4)
- Main risks: the expected decline in downloads after launch week, and a one-day spike from a competing app (a promotion, a viral app, a big sports or streaming event) landing exactly at the 10am PST check on Oct 1.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on whether Muse will be #1 on Oct 1, and no expert forecast on that question.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-10-01
- A possible expansion of Muse beyond the US and Canada would not directly change the US chart, though it could add publicity.
- Meta's ongoing marketing push (TechCrunch, 2026-09-25) could keep US downloads high.
- Rivals that could take #1: ChatGPT (#2 at last report), plus any new viral app, game launch or promotion with free items in late September or early October. I did not find any specific competing launch scheduled for Sep 25 to Oct 1.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I couldn't open any article directly because the proxy refused every page fetch. Everything below comes from search-result summaries. I left out all material dated after 2026-09-25.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question doesn't name a URL. In practice it resolves on Apple's US iPhone "Top Free Apps" chart, checked at 10am PST on 2026-10-01. Apple publishes this chart as a public feed (rss.applemarketingtools.com, US top-free). I couldn't get a reading as of 2026-09-25.
- Note that some coverage says Muse is "No. 1 in Productivity." That is a category ranking, not the overall Top Free chart. [letsdatascience](https://letsdatascience.com/news/meta-muse-reaches-top-us-app-store-rank-ebe5c682)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. As of about 2026-09-22, Muse (Meta's AI agent app) was reported at #1 on the US iPhone free chart, a streak that began about 2026-09-18. That puts it at roughly 7 days at #1 when forecasts close, with about 6 more days needed.
- 2026-09-22: Daring Fireball reported that Muse had overtaken ChatGPT as the top iPhone app. [Daring Fireball](https://daringfireball.net/linked/2026/09/22/meta-muse-app-store)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Undated, around late September: Crypto Briefing reported that Muse's "open rates sit significantly below" those of ChatGPT and Instagram. That points to weak retention, though chart rank is driven by new-download velocity, not retention. [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/meta-muse-app-store-retention/)
- 2026-09-22: Muse hit #1 on Canada's free iPhone chart, ahead of ChatGPT. [iPhone in Canada](https://www.iphoneincanada.ca/2026/09/22/metas-muse-hits-1-in-canada-outpaces-chatgpts-early-downloads/)
- 2026-09-21: TechCrunch reported that Muse was outpacing ChatGPT's early mobile launch. Apptopia counted about 1.8M iOS downloads in the US and Canada in its first 12 days, against 1.3M for ChatGPT over the same stretch. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/21/metas-muse-is-outpacing-chatgpts-early-mobile-launch/), [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262178990-muse-app-tops-app-store-chatgpt-meta-ai-agent-downloads-tradingkey)
- Undated, around 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-22: Muse reached #1 on the US App Store and was later reported as #1 on Google Play too. [Digg](https://digg.com/tech/w20loyzg)
- 2026-09-18: Muse reached #1 on the US iOS free chart, 10 days after launch. It ranked above ChatGPT, Polymarket and Kalshi, and ahead of Claude, Grok and Meta AI. [FoxData](https://foxdata.com/en/blogs/muse-from-meta-overtakes-chatgpt-for-app-store-no-1/)
- 2026-09-10: Muse was #2 on the US App Store, per Sensor Tower. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/10/metas-ai-agent-muse-is-now-the-no-2-app-in-the-us/)
- 2026-09-08: Muse launched.
- Slate's review called it possibly "something that's actually useful." [Slate](https://slate.com/technology/2026/09/meta-muse-ai-app-review.html)

## 4. Base rates
- I found no systematic data on how long a new #1 free app holds the top spot.
- Comparable cases: big AI launches such as ChatGPT (May 2023), Sora and DeepSeek (January 2025) held #1 for days to a few weeks. Event-driven apps, like Kalshi and Polymarket around the November 2024 election, take #1 only briefly. [AOL](https://www.aol.com/surge-election-betting-catapulted-kalshi-210242508.html)
- Muse's climb was gradual: #2 on day 2, #1 by day 10, and still #1 on day 14. That pattern suggests sustained demand, likely helped by promotion across Meta's apps, rather than a one-day spike. Yahoo Finance argued that its #1 ranking comes from a reason that "has nothing to do with if it's good," probably Meta's distribution. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/1-reason-why-meta-muse-151831317.html)
- Its competitors on the chart included ChatGPT, Vinted-type shopping apps, reward apps and the prediction-market apps.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has related markets by user Terminator2: "which app will be #1 on Apple's US free chart" and "where will Kalshi rank." [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/which-app-will-be-1-on-apples-us-fr), [Manifold Kalshi](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/where-will-kalshi-rank-on-apples-us)
- I couldn't find their prices as of 2026-09-25, or any Polymarket or Kalshi market on this question.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-10-01
- Possible competing launches: new AI app releases (OpenAI, Google, xAI), viral apps, or a game launch.
- Sports-betting and prediction-market apps tend to surge around big sporting weekends; NFL Week 4 falls around 2026-09-27/28.
- Download velocity normally decays a few weeks after launch, and the reported weak retention could speed that up.
- Meta could expand Muse to more platforms or regions or run marketing pushes, which could keep downloads high.
